active_work_package.title: Platform repository skeleton from the P0.2 design
active_work_package.objective: Create the place every later package lands, shaped so the modular monolith boundaries are tested rather than intended: the workspace and layout, the module registry, the seven dependency rules generated from it, the migration lint, the boundary test suite that proves both fire, the charter, these records and their schemas, and the CI skeleton. It implements no epic and creates no domain table.

stop_reason: The skeleton is complete on this branch and every check passes, but WP-001 cannot advance past ENGINEERING_READY. Two things are missing and neither is an agent's to supply. First, acceptance: the P0.2 design names a verifier who is not the implementer, and no independent review has happened. Second, and larger, BT-G0 is unrecorded: ARCH-001 is a draft, every ADR this repository depends on is DRAFT_REQUIRED, and FOUNDATION_SEQUENCE.md slice S01 needs five human review seats that are unfilled. Nothing beyond the skeleton may be built until an architecture authority records BT-G0 and a business authority records an expiring implementation grant. The primary action is NS-001, filling the repository administrator seat, because negative control 6 cannot be observed at all until branch protection exists.
known_divergence: The boundary rules in this repository are the PROPOSAL of a design at IN_REVIEW, not an accepted decision. P0.2 version 0.2 is IN_REVIEW in the guide repository and depends on five ADRs that are all DRAFT_REQUIRED; if ADR-001 narrows or widens the seven rules, the generator and the registry change with it and the boundary suite is re-run. Two negative controls of the P0.2 design are not observed here and are declared non-coverage rather than passed: control 6, a push straight to main and a merge with a failing check, which needs a human to record branch protection first; and the runtime half of every control, because nothing runs. Controls 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10, 11 and 12 are observed firing on deliberate fixtures under tests/boundaries/. The four module packages exist because the P0.2 design names them as the modules P0 builds; their contracts throw, which is the honest state, not a placeholder to be quietly filled.
